# QuasiCriticalDynamics

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A regime of neural network dynamics near criticality but not exactly at the critical point, balancing stability and responsiveness. Provides a biologically plausible operating point for neuromorphic systems, informing how TCC/iNEST architectures can achieve efficient information processing without instability.
